newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Pirelli confident about 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Pirelli confident about 1997 results.

text.p: Societe Internationale Pirelli SpA (SIP), a Swiss holding with a controlling stake in Italian tyre and cable maker Pirelli SpA, said it was confident that its 1998 results would develop positively.

In a statement issued after the shareholders' meeting of SPI, the holding company also said the meeting approved paying out a gross dividend of three Swiss francs per share and certificate on 7,041,295 shares and 2,105,767 certificates. The company will also allocate 1.5 million to reserves.
In 1996 SIP's group net profit rose to 137.4 million francs from 80.4 million.
